paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: JEDI storage-ring ALP search at COSY with a polarized deuteron beam. Main measured result: 90% CL upper bound on the oscillating deuteron EDM |d_AC^d|<6.4e-23 e.cm (Eq.37), converted to the axion-deuteron EDM coupling |g_adgamma|<1.7e-7 GeV^-2 (Eq.38), which equals the canonical AxionEDM coupling g_d=g_aNgamma (paper Eq.8 L=-(1/2)g_aNgamma a Nbar sigma_munu gamma5 N F^munu matches L=-(i/2)g_d a Nbar sigma gamma5 N F). Curve traced from the vector Fig.17 (sensitivity_plot_atten.pdf): the darker limit line = lower boundary of the excluded (filled) region, frequency 120.0-121.4 kHz mapped to m_a=h*f_AC=0.496-0.502 neV via the paper top axis. d_AC(f) converted point-by-point to g_adgamma using g=K*d_AC[e.cm]*m_a[eV] with K=5.31e24 anchored to the paper native pair (6.4e-23 e.cm <-> 1.7e-7 GeV^-2 at m_a=0.5 neV), reflecting g_adgamma ~ d_AC/a_0 with a_0 ~ 1/m_a (Eq.38). Only the directly-measured narrow mass band is reported, NOT the extrapolated diagonal cyan line in Fig.19 (which assumes equal sensitivity at all masses). Spiky limit line downsampled to 50 median-per-bin points. Assumed local DM density rho_LDM=0.55 GeV/cm^3 (enters a_0, hence g_adgamma; not rescaled). Green (Delta p=0.112) and blue (Delta p=0.138) ramp segments combined. Paper also derives ALP-gluon C_G^d/f_a (Fig.19/Axion_fa) and axion-neutron C_n/f_a (Fig.AxionNeutron) bounds; AxionEDM/g_adgamma is the headline coupling compared to nEDM/CASPEr/BeamEDM in Fig.19.
